paragraphs: The discussion below describes the business conducted by The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company, an Ohio corporation ("Scotts Miracle-Gro" and, together with its subsidiaries, the "Company," "we," "our" or "us"), including general developments in our business during fiscal 2025. Each reference in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K") to a "fiscal" year is to our fiscal year ended or ending, as applicable, on September 30 of the referenced year. For additional information on recent business developments, see "ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS" of this Form 10-K.

Through our U.S. Consumer and Other segments, we are the leading marketer of branded consumer lawn and garden products in North America. Our products are marketed under some of the most recognized brand names in the consumer lawn and garden industry. Our key consumer lawn and garden brands include Scotts® Turf Builder® lawn fertilizer and Scotts® grass seed products; Miracle-Gro® soil, plant food and gardening products; Ortho® herbicide and pesticide products; and Tomcat® rodent control and animal repellent products. We are the exclusive agent of Monsanto Company, a subsidiary of Bayer AG ("Monsanto"), for the marketing and distribution of certain of Monsanto's consumer Roundup®1 branded products within the United States ("U.S.") and certain other specified countries. In addition, we have an equity interest in Bonnie Plants, LLC, a joint venture with Alabama Farmers Cooperative, Inc. ("AFC"), focused on planting, growing, developing, distributing, marketing and selling live plants.

Through our Hawthorne segment, we are a leading provider of nutrients, lighting and other materials used for indoor and hydroponic gardening in North America. Our signature brands include General Hydroponics®, Gavita®, Botanicare®, Gro Pro®, Mother Earth®, Grower's Edge®, HydroLogic Purification System® and CYCO®.

Scotts Miracle-Gro traces its heritage to a company founded by O.M. Scott in Marysville, Ohio in 1868. In the mid-1900s, we became widely known for the development of quality lawn fertilizers and grass seeds that led to the creation of a new industry – consumer lawn care. In the 1990s, we significantly expanded our product offering with three leading brands in the U.S. home lawn and garden industry. In fiscal 1995, through a merger with Stern's Miracle-Gro Products, Inc., which was founded by Horace Hagedorn and Otto Stern in Long Island, New York in 1951, we acquired the Miracle-Gro® brand, the industry leader in water-soluble garden plant foods. In fiscal 1999, we acquired the Ortho® brand in the U.S. and obtained exclusive rights to market Monsanto's consumer Roundup® brand within the U.S. and other contractually specified countries, thereby adding industry-leading weed, pest and disease control products to our portfolio. Today, the Scotts®, Miracle-Gro®, Ortho® and Roundup® brands make us the most widely recognized company in the consumer lawn and garden industry in the U.S.
We divide our business into the following segments: •U.S. Consumer •Hawthorne •Other

U.S. Consumer consists of our consumer lawn and garden business in the United States. Hawthorne consists of our indoor and hydroponic gardening business. Other primarily consists of our consumer lawn and garden business in Canada. Corporate consists of general and administrative expenses and certain other income and expense items not allocated to the reportable business segments. Financial information about our segments for each of the three fiscal years ended September 30, 2025, 2024 and 2023 is presented in "NOTE 19. SEGMENT INFORMATION" of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in this Form 10-K.
1 Roundup® is a registered trademark of Monsanto Technology LLC, a company affiliated with Monsanto Company.
In our segments, we manufacture, market and sell lawn and garden products in the following categories:

Lawn Care: The lawn care category is designed to help users grow and enjoy the lawn they want. Products within this category include lawn fertilizer products under the Scotts®, O.M. SCOTT & SonsTM and Turf Builder® brand and sub-brand names; clover and grass seed products under the O.M. SCOTT & SonsTM, Scotts®, EZ Seed®, PatchMaster® and Thick'R LawnTM brand and sub-brand names; and lawn-related weed, pest and disease control products primarily under the Scotts® brand name, including sub-brands such as GrubEx®. The lawn care category also includes spreaders and other durables under the Scotts® brand name, including Turf Builder® EdgeGuard® spreaders and WhirlTM and Wizz® handheld spreaders.

Gardening and Landscape: The gardening and landscape category is designed to help consumers grow and enjoy flower and vegetable gardens and beautify landscaped areas. Products within this category include a complete line of water-soluble plant foods under the Miracle-Gro® brand and sub-brands such as LiquaFeed®; continuous-release plant foods under the Miracle-Gro® brand and sub-brands such as Shake ‘N Feed®; potting mixes, garden soils, ground cover and mulches under the Miracle-Gro®, Scotts®, Hyponex® and Earthgro® brand names; and organic garden products under the Miracle-Gro® Organic, Miracle-Gro® Organic ChoiceTM, Scotts® and Whitney Farms® brand names. Hydroponic and indoor gardening focused growing media and nutrients products are marketed under the Mother Earth®, Botanicare®, General Hydroponics® and CYCO® brand names.

Hydroponic hardware and growing environments: This category is designed to provide durable goods to grow plants, flowers and vegetables using little or no soil. Products within this category include trays, fans, filters, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, water pumps and irrigation supplies. These products are marketed under the Botanicare®, CAN-FANTM, CAN-FILTERS®, EcoPlus®, Gro Pro®, Grower's Edge® and Hydro-Logic Purification System® brand names.

Lighting: The lighting category is designed to provide growers a complete selection of lighting systems and components for use in hydroponic and indoor gardening applications. Products in this category include lighting controls, fixtures, cords and hangars, and are marketed under the Gavita® brand name.

Controls: The controls category is designed to help consumers protect their homes from pests and maintain external home areas. Insect control products are marketed under the Ortho® brand name, including Ortho Max®, Home Defense® and Bug B Gon® sub-brands; rodent control products are marketed under the Tomcat® and Ortho® brands; selective weed control products are marketed under the Ortho Weed B GonTM sub-brand; and non-selective weed killer products are marketed under the Groundclear® brand name. Hydroponic gardening focused controls products are marketed under the Alchemist®, Grower's Edge® and General Hydroponics® brand names.

Marketing Agreement: We are Monsanto's exclusive agent for the marketing and distribution of certain of Monsanto's consumer Roundup® branded products in the United States and certain other specified countries.

Our ability to manage our inventory levels to meet our customers' demand for our products is important for our business. Our production levels and inventory management goals for our products are based on estimates of demand and take into account production capacity, timing of shipments and inventory levels. Due to a number of factors, including manufacturing lead times, seasonal purchasing patterns and the potential for material price increases, we may carry additional inventory and increase our working capital and related financing requirements. Carrying additional inventory may increase our warehousing costs and result in excess inventory that may become difficult to manage, unusable or obsolete and adversely impact our ability to realize anticipated returns from product sales. If we overestimate or underestimate either channel or retail demand for any of our products during a given season, we may not maintain appropriate inventory levels, which could negatively impact our net sales, profit margins, net earnings, working capital and/or cash flow, hinder our ability to meet customer demand, result in loss of customers or cause us to incur excess and obsolete inventory charges or excess warehouse storage costs.

There are indications of increased economic uncertainty in the U.S. including the potential for an economic recession. Impacts of such general economic weakness include, without limitation: reduced credit availability; reduced liquidity; volatility in credit, equity and foreign exchange markets; increasing job losses, bankruptcies and rising interest rates. In recent years, there have been instances of Congress and the President failing to reach agreement on federal budgetary and spending matters. A government shutdown or a default by the U.S. government on its debt obligations, or related credit-rating downgrades could also have adverse effects on the broader global economy and contribute to, or worsen, an economic recession. We believe that any extended or renewed economic disruptions or deterioration in the global economy could have an adverse impact on our business, financial condition or results of operations.

In addition, consumers may reduce discretionary spending during periods of economic uncertainty, which could reduce sales volumes of our products or result in a shift in our product mix from higher margin to lower margin products. Adverse economic conditions have included or resulted, and could continue to include or result, in a significant increase in inflation, which could have a material adverse impact on our business, financial condition or results of operations.

Through our U.S. Consumer and Other segments, we are the leading marketer of branded consumer lawn and garden products in North America. Our products are marketed under some of the most recognized brand names in the industry. Our key consumer lawn and garden brands include Scotts® Turf Builder® lawn fertilizer and Scotts® grass seed products; Miracle-Gro® soil, plant food and gardening products; Ortho® herbicide and pesticide products; and Tomcat® rodent control and animal repellent products. We are the exclusive agent of Monsanto for the marketing and distribution of certain of Monsanto's consumer Roundup® branded products within the United States and certain other specified countries. In addition, we have an equity interest in Bonnie Plants, LLC, a joint venture with AFC, focused on planting, growing, developing, distributing, marketing and selling live plants.

Through our Hawthorne segment, we are a leading provider of nutrients, lighting and other materials used for indoor and hydroponic gardening in North America. Our signature brands include General Hydroponics®, Gavita®, Botanicare®, Gro Pro®, Mother Earth®, Grower's Edge®, HydroLogic Purification System® and CYCO®.

As a leading consumer branded lawn and garden company, our product development and marketing efforts are largely focused on providing innovative and differentiated products and continually increasing brand and product awareness to inspire consumers to create retail demand. We have implemented this model for a number of years by focusing on research and development, advertising and consumer activation programs with our customers to support and promote our consumer lawn and garden products and brands. We continually explore new and innovative ways to communicate with consumers. We believe that we receive a significant benefit from these expenditures and we anticipate continued growth in these investments in the future, with the continuing objective of driving category growth and profitably maintaining and/or increasing market share.

Our consumer lawn and garden business in any year is susceptible to weather conditions in the markets in which our products are sold. These climate conditions may adversely impact the sale of certain products or increase demand for other products thereby making the overall impact of abnormal or extreme weather conditions on us difficult to predict. We believe that our diversified product line and our geographic diversification reduce this risk, although to a lesser extent in a year in which unfavorable weather is geographically widespread and extends across a significant portion of the lawn and garden season. We also believe that weather conditions in any one year, positive or negative, do not materially impact longer-term category growth trends.

Due to the seasonal nature of the consumer lawn and garden business, significant portions of our U.S. Consumer and Other segment net sales ship to our retail customers during our second and third fiscal quarters, as noted in the following table. Our annual net sales are further concentrated in the second and third fiscal quarters by retailers who rely on our ability to deliver products closer to when consumers buy our products.

paragraphs: 下列討論說明本公司 Scotts Miracle-Gro Company，一家Ohio州公司（"Scotts Miracle-Gro"及，連同其子公司，"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的"或"我們"），所進行的業務，包括我們在財務年度2025年業務的一般發展情形。本年度報告表10-K（"表10-K"）中所有提及"財務"年份的參考，均指我們財務年度結算或結算，依情況而定，為參考年份9月30日。如需更多有關近期業務發展的資訊，請參閱本表10-K的"項目7. 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"。

透過我們的美國消費者及其它業務部門，我們是北美地區首屈一指的 branded 消費者草坪與園藝產品經銷商。我們的產品以消費者草坪與園藝產業中一些最受認可的品牌名稱進行行銷。我們的關鍵消費者草坪與園藝品牌包括 Scotts® Turf Builder® 草坪肥料與 Scotts® 草種產品；Miracle-Gro® 土壤、植物肥料與園藝產品；Ortho® 植物除草劑與農藥產品；以及 Tomcat® 鼠類控制與動物驅離產品。我們是 Monsanto Company，為 Bayer AG（"Monsanto"）的子公司，於美國（"美國"）及某些其他指定國家行銷與分銷 Monsanto 消費者 Roundup®1 品牌產品的獨家代理商。此外，我們在 Bonnie Plants, LLC 持有權益，該公司為與 Alabama Farmers Cooperative, Inc.（"AFC"）的合資企業，專注於種植、成長、開發、分銷、行銷與銷售活體植物。
透過我們的 Hawthorne 部門，我們是北美地區主要提供用於室內與水耕園藝的營養素、照明及其他材料的供應商。我們的標誌性品牌包括 General Hydroponics®、Gavita®、Botanicare®、Gro Pro®、Mother Earth®、Grower's Edge®、HydroLogic Purification System® 以及 CYCO®。
我們將業務分為以下部門：•美國消費者 •Hawthorne •其他
美國消費者部門包括我們在美國的消費者草坪與園藝業務。Hawthorne 部門包括我們的室內與水耕園藝業務。其他部門主要為我們在加拿大的消費者草坪與園藝業務。公司部門包括一般及行政費用與某些其他收入與費用項目，這些項目未分配至應報告的業務部門。關於我們各部門在財務年度2025年、2024年及2023年結算於9月30日的財務資訊，請參閱本表10-K所附的「附註19. 部門資訊」。
1 Roundup® 是 Monsanto Technology LLC 的註冊商標，該公司與 Monsanto Company 有關聯。
在各部門中，我們製造、行銷與銷售草坪與園藝產品，分為以下類別：

園藝保養：園藝保養類別旨在協助用戶種植並享受他們想要的草坪。此類別產品包括 Scotts®、O.M. SCOTT & SonsTM 和 Turf Builder® 品牌及子品牌下的草坪肥料產品；O.M. SCOTT & SonsTM、Scotts®、EZ Seed®、PatchMaster® 和 Thick'R LawnTM 品牌及子品牌下的 Clover 和 Grass Seed 產品；以及主要以 Scotts® 品牌名義銷售的與草坪相關的除草、害蟲及病害控制產品，包括子品牌如 GrubEx®。園藝保養類別也包含以 Scotts® 品牌名義銷售的撒播機與其他耐用產品，包括 Turf Builder® EdgeGuard® 撒播機與 WhirlTM 和 Wizz® 手持撒播機。

園藝與景觀：園藝與景觀類別旨在協助消費者種植並享受花園與蔬菜園區，並美化景觀區域。此類別產品包括以 Miracle-Gro® 品牌及子品牌如 LiquaFeed® 為名義的完整水溶性植物肥料線；以 Miracle-Gro® 品牌及子品牌如 Shake ‘N Feed® 為名義的持續釋放植物肥料；以 Miracle-Gro®、Scotts®、Hyponex® 和 Earthgro® 品牌名義的盆栽混合土、園藝土壤、地被植物與覆蓋物；以及以 Miracle-Gro® Organic、Miracle-Gro® Organic ChoiceTM、Scotts® 和 Whitney Farms® 品牌名義的有機園藝產品。以 Mother Earth®、Botanicare®、General Hydroponics® 和 CYCO® 品牌名義銷售的水耕與室內園藝專用的生長介質與營養素產品。
水耕硬體與生長環境：此類別旨在提供耐用產品，用以種植植物、花朵與蔬菜，使用極少或無土壤。此類別產品包括託盤、風扇、過濾器、加濕器、除濕器、水泵與灌溉用品。這些產品以 Botanicare®、CAN-FANTM、CAN-FILTERS®、EcoPlus®、Gro Pro®、Grower's Edge® 和 Hydro-Logic Purification System® 品牌名義銷售。
照明：照明類別旨在為種植者提供完整的照明系統與零組件，用於水耕與室內園藝應用。此類別產品包括照明控制、燈具、電線與吊架，並以 Gavita® 品牌名義銷售。

控制系統：控制系統類別旨在協助消費者保護其住宅免受害蟲侵害並維護住宅外部區域。除蟲產品以 Ortho® 品牌名義銷售，包括 Ortho Max®、Home Defense® 和 Bug B Gon® 子品牌；鼠類控制產品以 Tomcat® 和 Ortho® 品牌名義銷售；選擇性除草產品以 Ortho Weed B GonTM 子品牌名義銷售；非選擇性除草劑產品以 Groundclear® 品牌名義銷售。專注於水耕園藝的控制產品以 Alchemist®、Grower's Edge® 和 General Hydroponics® 品牌名義銷售。
行銷協議：我們是 Monsanto 的獨家代理商，負責美國及某些指定國家的 Monsanto 消費者 Roundup® 品牌產品的行銷與分銷。

透過本公司 U.S. Consumer 與 Other 分部，本公司為北美地區首屈一指的 branded 消費者草坪與園藝產品行銷商。本公司產品以業內最知名的品牌名稱行銷。本公司主要的消費者草坪與園藝品牌包括 Scotts® Turf Builder® 草坪肥料與 Scotts® 草種產品；Miracle-Gro® 土壤、植物肥料與園藝產品；Ortho® 除草劑與農藥產品；以及 Tomcat® 鼠類控制與動物驅離產品。本公司為 Monsanto 在美國及某些指定國家行銷與分銷 Monsanto 消費者 Roundup® 品牌產品的獨家代理商。此外，本公司在 Bonnie Plants, LLC 持有權益，該公司為與 AFC 共同成立的合資公司，專注於種植、成長、開發、分銷、行銷與銷售活體植物。
透過本公司 Hawthorne 分部，本公司為北美地區主要的室內及水耕園藝用營養素、照明及其他材料供應商。本公司標誌性品牌包括 General Hydroponics®、Gavita®、Botanicare®、Gro Pro®、Mother Earth®、Grower's Edge®、HydroLogic Purification System® 以及 CYCO®。

作為一家首屈一指的消費者品牌草坪與園藝公司，本公司產品開發與行銷努力主要聚焦於提供創新且差異化的產品，並持續增加品牌與產品的知名度以激勵消費者創造零售需求。本公司已實施此模式多年，透過專注於研究與開發、廣告以及與客戶的消費者活化計畫，以支持與推廣本公司消費者草坪與園藝產品與品牌。本公司持續探尋新的創新方式與消費者溝通。本公司相信這些支出為本公司帶來顯著效益，並預期未來持續增加這些投資，以持續推動類別成長並有利地維持與/或增加市場佔有率。

本公司任何一年的消費者草坪與園藝業務均會受到所銷售市場天氣條件的影響。這些氣候條件可能不利於某些產品的銷售，或增加其他產品的需求，因此使異常或極端天氣條件對本公司整體影響難以預測。本公司相信本公司多樣化的產品線與地理分散化可降低此風險，不過在不利天氣地理範圍廣泛且覆蓋草坪與園藝季節大部分的年份，此風險降低幅度較小。本公司也相信任何一年的天氣條件，無論正面或負面，均不會對長期類別成長趨勢產生重大影響。
由於消費者草坪與園藝業務具有季節性，本公司 U.S. Consumer 與 Other 分部的大量淨銷售額會在財務年度的第二與第三季運送到零售客戶，如下列表格所示。本公司年度淨銷售額進一步集中於第二與第三季，因零售商依賴本公司能將產品更接近消費者購買時間點交付。

與我們業務相關之風險
若我們低估或高估產品需求，且未能維持適當之存貨水準，將可能對我們之淨銷售額及/或營運資金造成負面影響。
經濟衰退及經濟不確定性可能對我們產品之需求產生不利影響。
原料、燃料或運輸成本之供應中斷或價格上漲，可能對我們之營運成果產生不利影響。
我們可能無法成功開發新產品線及產品，或改善現有產品線及產品。
我們之行銷活動可能無法成功。
我們所處市場之高度競爭性可能對我們維持或成長營收能力產生不利影響。
本公司製造業務，包括對第三方製造商之依賴，可能對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司業務面臨來自美國境外採購與製造之風險，以及關稅及/或國際貿易戰之風險。
本公司對供應商之有限基礎之依賴，可能導致本公司業務中斷，並對財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司用以分佈產品之運輸渠道中斷，可能對本公司毛利率及獲利能力產生負面影響。
本公司國際業務使本公司面臨國際運作之成本及風險。
若發生災難，本公司災難復原及業務持續性計畫可能失敗，此可能對本公司營運造成負面中斷。
氣候變遷及不利天氣條件可能對本公司財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司業務可能因企業公民責任及永續性事項（包括氣候變遷）及/或本公司對此等事項之報導而受到負面影響。
產品回收或其它產品責任聲請，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
若本公司無法有效執行電商業務，將可能影響本公司聲譽及營運成果。
若本公司資訊或營運科技系統無法充分運作，或本公司遭竊取資料或遭受網路攻擊，可能影響本公司營運、財務狀況或聲譽。
本公司可能無法充分保護對業務至關重要的智慧財產權及其他專有權利。
本公司之成功取決於關鍵人員之留任與可得性，以及高階管理階層之有效繼任。
本公司員工裁員可能導致不理想後果，並對業務及營運成果造成不利影響。
與本公司併購、貸款及融資活動相關之風險
本公司之負債可能限制本公司之靈活性，並對財務狀況造成不利影響。
長期或持續較高的利率可能會對本公司的財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生不利影響。
全球經濟及資本市場情勢可能限制本公司取得資金的管道及/或增加取得資金的成本。
收購、其他戰略合作夥伴關係及投資可能會導致營運困難、股本稀釋及其他有害後果，這些後果可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 本表 10-K，包括 herein 所附之附屬文件及 herein 所引用之資訊，以及我們 2025 年年度股東報告（我們稱為「2025 年年度報告」），包含「向前看聲明」，根據 1933 年證券法第 27A 節（經修訂）及交易法第 21E 節之定義，這些向前看聲明受風險與不確定性影響。有關我們預期或預測未來將發生之活動、事件與發展，包括但不限於與我們未來成長與獲利目標及旨在提高總股東價值之策略相關之資訊，為向前看聲明，基於管理階層之估計、假設與預測。向前看聲明亦包括但不限於有關我們未來經濟與財務狀況及營運結果、管理階層之計畫與目標及我們對表現與這些計畫與目標之假設，以及股息發放與普通股買回金額與時間或現金流之其他用途。向前看聲明通常透過使用「指引」、「展望」、「預測」、「相信」、「目標」、「預測」、「估計」、「預測」、「策略」、「可能」、「目標」、「預期」、「預期」、「意圖」、「計畫」、「預見」、「可能」、「將」、「應」及其他相似詞彙與變體來識別。
本表 10-K 及我們 2025 年年度報告中之向前看聲明僅為預測，實際結果可能因多種因素而與管理階層預期有重大差異，包括下列所描述之因素。所有歸因於我們或為我們工作之人士之向前看聲明，皆明確以這些風險因素及其他我們在其他 SEC 檔案及公開溝通中所提出之警示聲明為準。

您應在這些風險與不確定性之背景下評估向前看聲明，並謹慎勿過度依賴這些聲明。這些因素可能不包含對您而言重要的所有因素。我們無法保證我們將實現預期或預測之結果或發展，即使 substantially 實現，這些結果或發展也可能以我們預期之方式影響我們或我們之營運。本表 10-K 及我們 2025 年年度報告中所作之向前看聲明，係基於管理階層對未來事件之當前觀點與假設，僅為其日期之陳述。我們不負有更新這些風險因素之發展或公開宣佈任何向前看聲明之修正，或修正以反映未來事件或發展之義務，除非法律要求。

我們管理存貨水準以符合客戶對我們產品之需求，對我們業務至關重要。我們產品之生產水準與存貨管理目標係基於需求之估計，並考量生產能力、出貨時間及存貨水準。由於多種因素，包括製造週期、季節性採購模式及材料價格上漲之潛在可能，我們可能持有額外存貨，並增加我們之營運資金與相關融資需求。持有額外存貨可能增加我們之倉儲成本，並導致存貨過多，難以管理、無法使用或過時，並對我們實現產品銷售預期回報之能力產生不利影響。若我們在某個季節對任何產品之通路或零售需求估計過高或過低，我們可能無法維持適當之存貨水準，這可能會對我們之淨銷售額、毛利、淨利潤、營運資金及/或現金流產生負面影響，影響我們滿足客戶需求之能力，導致客戶流失，或使我們產生過多及過時存貨費用或過多倉儲費用。

美國經濟不確定性增加之跡象包括經濟衰退之潛在可能。此類普遍經濟疲弱之影響包括但不限於：信貸可得性減少；流動性減少；信貸、股權及外匯市場波動；失業率增加、破產增加及利率上升。近年來，國會與總統在聯邦預算與支出事項上未能達成協議之情況時有發生。美國政府關閉或美國政府未能履行其債務義務，或相關信用評級降級，也可能對廣泛全球經濟產生不利影響，並導致或惡化經濟衰退。我們認為，任何延長或重啟之經濟動盪或全球經濟惡化，可能對我們業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生不利影響。
此外，消費者可能在經濟不確定時期減少非必要支出，這可能減少我們產品之銷售量，或導致我們產品組合從高毛利產品轉向低毛利產品。不利經濟條件已包括或導致，或可能繼續包括或導致，通貨膨脹顯著增加，這可能對我們業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生重大不利影響。
